doctrine_note: Blind round-1 posterior. Inputs were the brain (s103.4, 66 plays) + renders/ng_refine_s95/grp21_state.json ONLY. No forecasts/grp21.json, no g21_mbo_evidence.json, no g21_actual.json, no exit-state or handoff file, no raw tape. The OLD BLIND stays the core predictor; the never-masked MBO trade-flow read (session/phase signed flow, big prints, L1) is a posterior update on direction confidence and path, never a replacement. The MBO BOOK layer STANDS DOWN in full - a blind state carries no book_trustworthy verdict and L1 quote_bid_share 0.507 with an IQR of 0.30-0.714 is a coin flip. Magnitude is derived from a generator-loss argument and a level target, with vol_regime used only as a sanity band (it is masked at the 0605 vintage, is known to run low, and its staleness concentrates 1.71x on exactly my day-class). The PRIOR-OVER-STATE turn/exhaustion gate was run BEFORE any sign was emitted, per daytype.friday_turn_exhaustion_gate; its full worksheet is in the day object.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: Both of my merged G20 contributions are un-runnable in the blind for one missing field, and it is a one-line fix.

finding_1_phase_volume_is_not_served.statement: flow.passive_ladder_displacement was merged with a MANDATORY second limb - 'final-phase volume AT OR ABOVE the session maximum' - and daytype.friday_exit_close_location_over_flow_shape was merged with a (VOLUME, NET) PAIR condition. tape_conditions serves phase_signed_flow and phase_b_share and does NOT serve phase_volume. So on the blind's served state only limb (a) of each is computable.
finding_1_phase_volume_is_not_served.why_this_matters: Both limbs are NON-PRICE and therefore blind-legitimate in principle. On G20 I had the phase volumes (ph1 4,715 / ph2 51,424 / ph3 60,930) only because they came from the MBO evidence file, which the blind does not get. The mandatory limb - the one B forced in precisely because without it the play is a false-positive machine - is the limb the blind cannot see. As served, a play merged as blind-available is refine-only.
finding_1_phase_volume_is_not_served.consequence_on_0612: On the 0611 exit I can evaluate limb (a) (ph3 |net| 378 / ph2 2,654 = 14.2%, FAILS the ~5% bar, so the play correctly does not fire) but I could not have confirmed a fire if limb (a) had passed. The play did not fire here, so nothing was lost on this day - but the next time limb (a) passes in a blind, the specialist has to either assert the play on half its evidence or stand it down, and both are wrong answers.
finding_1_phase_volume_is_not_served.fix: Add phase_volume (a 3-element list alongside phase_signed_flow / phase_b_share) to tape_conditions. It is non-price, it is already computed upstream to produce the b_shares, and it makes two merged plays blind-available as written. NOT proposing a brain edit - this is a state-builder field, and I have edited nothing.
finding_1_phase_volume_is_not_served.self_scoring: This is a finding against my own play, not for it.

finding_2_week2_measurement_basis_is_dis.statement: The never-masked tape shows a hard break at the 0614/0615 boundary that is NOT a market event. Week-1 prior sessions (0608-0611) run 38,434-47,040 trades / 88,893-110,168 lots at a 1.0-tick median spread. Week-2 prior sessions (0615-0618) run 6,262-22,490 trades / 12,041-46,452 lots at a 2.0-tick median spread. Monday 0615 is 6.6x thinner than Monday 0608.
finding_2_week2_measurement_basis_is_dis.why_it_is_not_the_market: flow_calendar carries front_symbol_calendar = NGN26 and futures_expiry_date = 2026-06-26 on EVERY day of the block, so on the calendar-front basis the leg never changes. But NGN26 at dte 8-5 is in the two weeks BEFORE expiry, normally the MOST liquid stretch of its life, not a 6.6x collapse. The store is source_store 'nymex_cont_n0'; a continuous n0 series rolling to a thinner deferred leg reproduces exactly this signature, and it is the NG.v.0/NG.n.0 basis whipsaw the brain already records from the G11 expiry week.
finding_2_week2_measurement_basis_is_dis.consequence_for_A_B_C_D: Any flow MAGNITUDE compared across the 0614/0615 boundary is comparing two different instruments. Week-2 net-flow and volume readings must NOT be scaled against week-1 references, and the week-2 big-print samples (n = 0, 6, 2, 16, 19) fall straight into the thin-tape guard's q1: 0616's 0.841 on 6 prints and 0619's 0.303 on 19 prints are dispersion, not signal, and flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard stands them down at the ~0.60 bar.
finding_2_week2_measurement_basis_is_dis.scope_of_my_own_exposure: NONE on my day. 0612 reads prior session 0611, which is week-1 internal and on the same basis as 0608-0610. My comparisons are all inside the clean segment. I am flagging this for the owners of 0615-0619, not excusing my own number.

two_consequences: SEQUENCING: my session runs 19 of its 21 hours on a positioning read that says the covering fuel is SPENT, and its last 90 minutes and its entire weekend handoff on a read that says the shorts are RE-LOADING to a new 1y low. The day-move and the handoff are conditioned by different vintages. This is not a subtlety to smooth over - it is why my day is DOWN and my monday_bias is UP without contradiction.

magnitude_derivation.principle: Derived from generator loss against a level target, NOT fitted and NOT scaled off vol_regime. On G20 I re-earned a Friday magnitude with no vol_regime term at all, off a level; vol_regime here is masked at the 0605 vintage, is documented ~53% low on net sigma and ~46% low on mean range, and its staleness concentrates 1.71x on CATALYST/SEAM days - my class. That route is taken again by choice, not by necessity.
magnitude_derivation.step_1_count_the_generators: 0611 carried THREE down-generators simultaneously: the GSCI terminal tranche (roll day 5), the BCOM tranche (roll day 4), and a bearish realized EIA print. It produced -3,772 of net sell on the week's maximum volume. On 0612, TWO of the three are gone: GSCI's window closed at the 0611 close, and the print is behind with the next one 6 days out. What remains is BCOM's fifth and final tranche.
magnitude_derivation.step_2_isolate_the_roll_only_baseline: 0609 and 0610 are roll-window sessions with NO print: -1,704 and -1,813, mean -1,759. That is the two-index mechanical baseline. 0611's -3,772 is therefore ~-2,013 of print-day excess over it. 0608 (+3,261) is the week's only positive session and is excluded as the post-weekend outlier.
magnitude_derivation.step_3_size_the_0612_residual: With GSCI out entirely and BCOM on its last of five tranches, the residual mechanical sell is a small fraction of the -1,759 two-index baseline - on the order of -400 lots of net, not thousands. 0612 should be the QUIETEST directional session of the week on the front leg.
magnitude_derivation.step_4_the_roll_was_already_partly_pre_p: contract_structure at the 0605 vintage - BEFORE the roll window opened on bd 6 - already shows the front cheapening against the next: calendar_front_next_spread -0.041 with chg_1d -0.007, chg_3d -0.015, chg_5d -0.013. The market pre-positioned for this roll. An already-priced mechanical flow delivers less on its terminal day, which caps the number rather than extending it.

step_5_two_independent_derivations.flow_proportional: Expected 0612 net flow ~-400 against 0611's -3,772 is ~11%. Applied naively to a 0611 move at roughly sigma_5 scale that gives ~-130. REJECTED AS THE ANSWER because it assumes an impact linearity I cannot calibrate without price and because it ignores a session's non-mechanical variance floor. Kept as the LOWER bound of the derivation.
step_5_two_independent_derivations.day_class_floor: A no-catalyst summer Friday in a regime with n0_net_sigma_20 = 862 and a RISING activity trend (1.448) does not sit at -130. The quiet-directional-Friday class lands at ~0.35-0.50 sigma_20, i.e. -300 to -430. Kept as the UPPER bound.

magnitude_derivation.step_6_the_number: -340. Midpoint of the two derivations, weighted toward the day-class floor because the flow-proportional route rests on an uncalibratable coefficient. -340 = 0.39x n0_net_sigma_20 (862) and 0.30x n0_net_sigma_5 (1,117). It is deliberately UNDER what a straight extension of the week's accelerating sell (-1,704 -> -1,813 -> -3,772) would suggest, because two of the three drivers of that acceleration expire at the 0611 close.
magnitude_derivation.band_asymmetry: [-900, +300]. Down-shoulder wider because every named generator present points down and none of the up-channels is armed intraday. Upper shoulder kept genuinely positive - not token - for three reasons: the roll seller finishing can be front-run within the session; the ICE HH books were already re-shorting on the live vintage (finding_5); and dte 9 leaves a thin squeeze tail. Per my lens an expiry two weeks out is TAIL risk, never a p50 covering trigger, so it sits in the band and not in the number.
magnitude_derivation.range_vs_net_note: Per daytype.thin_session_range_invariance (A, G20): a low-NET day does not imply a low RANGE. I expect a realized range near regime-normal (n0_range_20_mean 1,266, range_5_mean 1,612) despite a -340 net. That governs the PATH, not the day-move, and my p50 curve carries a real -520 excursion against a -340 close for exactly that reason.

days.continuation_vs_reversal_detail: The DAY-MOVE continues the 0611 sell direction. The last 2.5 hours reverse. Both statements are load-bearing: the first sets the number, the second sets the handoff, and conflating them is how a Friday cascades.

Magnitude rests on a generator-loss argument I cannot calibrate blind, which is where the 0.58 rather than 0.7 comes from. The path shape (low into the settle, relief into the close) is the most mechanically determined part of this day and I hold it more confidently than the number.

evidence_rejected.item: big_print_b_share 0.572 size-weighted on 160 big prints (two-sided 0.581) - big money on the BID while the count tape sold -3,772
evidence_rejected.nominal_effect: 160 prints puts this in the thickest quartile, so flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard does NOT apply and the reading clears both the 0.55 bar and q4's 0.547 equal-rate bar. Taken at face value it fires a BUY.
rejected_on_two_independent_grounds: (a) SCOPE. flow.price_free_absorption_proxy is explicitly HALF-ONLY: its precondition is aggregate session signed flow POSITIVE. 0611 is -3,772. The mirror arm is REFUTED in the brain with four measured G20 counterexamples (0527 .529 -> +2,100; 0528 .522 -> -160; 0604 .533 -> -1,340; 0603 .476 -> +1,130 - two up, two down, and the one sell reading preceded the second-biggest up day). Under a negative count tape this channel carries no next-session information. This is precisely the recorded negative that exists to stop me re-deriving it, and it stopped me.

(b) MECHANICAL CONTAMINATION, independent of (a). 0611 sits INSIDE the index-roll window on the FRONT leg. A commodity index roll sells the front and buys the deferred, and its counterparty takes the other side of the calendar spread by BUYING the front in blocks. big_prints_n jumped 108 -> 160 (+48%) on the terminal GSCI day - the block-print footprint of a roll tranche, not a positioning tell. The EIA print day also inflates volume, so both explanations are present at once; I state the conjunction rather than pick the one I like.
evidence_rejected.general_form_offered: During an index-roll window, the size-weighted big-print channel on the FRONT leg is contaminated by the roll's spread counterparty and is not a positioning tell. Offered as an observation with a mechanism, NOT proposed as a play - n=1 and I have not measured it across roll windows.

days.mbo_verdict: A quiet, mechanically-determined down Friday whose last two hours turn - and whose handoff points the opposite way to its day-move, for a reason that is dated rather than contradictory. The never-masked flow record is unambiguous through the week: from 0609 the front leg sold monotonically and with acceleration (-1,704, -1,813, -3,772), peaking on 0611 when three down-generators stacked - GSCI's terminal roll tranche, BCOM's fourth, and a bearish realized EIA print (+108 vs +101, +33 vs the 5-yr). Two of those three expire at the 0611 close. What is left on 0612 is BCOM's fifth and final tranche against a spread that had already begun cheapening the front before the window even opened. So the direction carries but the size collapses: -340, roughly a third of a 20-session sigma, and deliberately under a straight extension of the week. The path is the most determined part of the day - drift through a morning with no scheduled binary, the mechanical low into the 14:00-14:30 settle as the last tranche clears, then relief into the close because the seller is finished and does not come back for the remainder of the block. That gives a close roughly a third off the low, which per daytype.friday_exit_close_location_over_flow_shape is the field the weekend actually consumes. Then the sequencing: for 19 of my 21 hours the live positioning read says the covering fuel is SPENT (WoW +19,572, pctile 4.72), and at 15:30 ET the new COT prints -7,763 WORSENING to a 2.83 1y pctile - a new one-year extreme. The shorts re-loaded. The ICE HH books had already said so one report earlier. So the day is DOWN on a mechanical seller and the seam is UP on a loaded spring, and the two do not fight because they are answers to different questions asked at different times. What I refuse to do is hand B a gap number: the up prior arms on the WORSENING print, but the +580 quantum from G19 is explicitly block-specific and only the SIGN rule generalises, so B gets a sign and a mechanism, not a magnitude to anchor on.
